canonical.name: rfc8785_values
canonical.why: Numbers, escapes and literals, from RFC 8785 §3.2.2.

canonical.name: rfc8785_sorting
canonical.why: Member names sorted by UTF-16 code units, from RFC 8785 §3.2.3.
inputs: {"\u20ac":"Euro Sign","\r":"Carriage Return","\ufb33":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh","1":"One","\ud83d\ude00":"Emoji: Grinning Face","\u0080":"Control","\u00f6":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis"}
canonical.expected: {"\r":"Carriage Return","1":"One","":"Control","ö":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis","€":"Euro Sign","😀":"Emoji: Grinning Face","דּ":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh"}

canonical.name: nested_state
canonical.why: A state with nested objects and arrays: every object is sorted at every depth, array order is kept.

canonical.name: numbers
canonical.why: Numbers are IEEE 754 doubles written as ECMAScript writes them: -0 is 0, exponents from 1e21 and below 1e-6, and 9007199254740993 cannot be held exactly.

canonical.name: unicode
canonical.why: Strings are not normalized: precomposed and decomposed forms stay different. Only control characters, the quote and the backslash are escaped; DEL, slash and non-ASCII are written as they are.

canonical.name: same_state
canonical.why: Member order, whitespace, number spelling and string escapes differ, but these are the same state.

refuse.name: truncated_body
refuse.why: The last record carries 0x01, so records are missing (§7.4).

refuse.name: other_key_id
refuse.why: The aes128gcm keyid is not the session id (§7.4).

refuse.name: response_for_other_request
refuse.why: A response signed against the action request, opened as the answer to render_query, fails (§7.3).

refuse.name: response_stripped_cache
refuse.why: Asgard-Cache removed from a response that signed it (§7.3).

refuse.name: response_wrong_coding
refuse.why: Asgard-Content-Coding flipped from identity to gzip (§7.4).

refuse.name: event_renumbered
refuse.why: An event whose id was changed from 7 to 8 fails its sig (§8.1).

refuse.name: event_enc_flipped
refuse.why: An event whose enc was flipped fails its sig (§8.1).

refuse.name: state_lone_surrogate
refuse.why: A state string holding a lone surrogate is not I-JSON, so it has no canonical state (§5.1, RFC 8785).

refuse.name: point_not_on_curve
refuse.why: A client_public that is not on P-256 is refused with 422 (§6.1).
